dimension_justifications.soundness: The bounded factorial, witnesses, selected oracle, and matched controls are strong, but GDN and upstream computations retain common-mode risk.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The paper is candid and legible, but the Table 4 generation baseline and stale claim locators need correction.
dimension_justifications.contribution: Useful integrated audit, but one non-optimized path and no detector incremental-value evidence.

paper_summary: ForkAudit combines a KV-by-GDN ownership factorial, exact relational checks, selected dense attention rows, live faults, and explicit denominators.
strongest_verified_contribution: The phase-aware GDN range witness across all 96 primary configurations.
questions: Which ordinary checks detect each mutant?

issues.observed_evidence: The paper does not report ordinary detector outcomes or unique/earlier ForkAudit catches.
issues.why_it_matters: Gate-targeted faults can otherwise be tautological detector unit tests.
issues.required_fix: Add a preregistered per-mutant detector matrix and realistic output-preserving fault.
issues.verification_test: Fresh matched/mutant executions with all detector outcomes and first failure.

issues.observed_evidence: One model/runtime/geometry/schedule and no cancellation or reclamation are tested.
issues.why_it_matters: Reusability depends on surviving a nontrivial lifecycle or implementation change.
issues.required_fix: Validate unchanged predicates on an optimized/independent path or added lifecycle geometry, or narrow the title and contribution.
issues.verification_test: Freeze predicates and execute unchanged replay/mutations on the new setting.

issues.observed_evidence: The independent oracle covers selected attention rows but not GDN or end-to-end computation.
issues.why_it_matters: Hybrid-specific computation remains under a common-mode oracle.
issues.required_fix: Add an independent GDN transition oracle and broader predeclared attention sampling, or retain narrow wording.
issues.verification_test: Candidate-independent recomputation with frozen tolerances and a seeded common-mode fault.

issues.observed_evidence: Generation peaks are smaller than final deltas despite a caption claiming one common baseline.
issues.why_it_matters: The phase-shift conclusion needs exact subtraction baselines.
issues.required_fix: Define each column algebraically and relabel generation peak as an increment above generation-start allocation.
issues.verification_test: Recompute each cell from archived phase snapshots.

issues.why_it_matters: The map is advertised as the quantitative verification path.
issues.required_fix: Regenerate all locators against the final PDF.
issues.verification_test: Automated locator audit plus spot checks.

review_limitations: The raw 892 MB replay package was not in the frozen reviewer object.
